passages.provision_quote: shall temporarily be used for every congressional election for a term of office commencing on or after the date this subdivision becomes operative and before the certification of new congressional boundary lines drawn by the Citizens Redistricting Commission
passages.note: The measure moves congressional map-drawing away from the commission only until 2031, which the annex treats as a change of map-drawer that is not permanent.

rows.reasoning: Rivas authored ACA 8 (2025-2026), which “notwithstanding the authority of the Citizens Redistricting Commission” substitutes legislature-drawn congressional maps only until the commission draws again in 2031, so the change of map-drawer is temporary and matches no rung's institution clause. Its own declaration that it is state policy “to support the use of fair, independent, and nonpartisan redistricting commissions nationwide” names neither “no elected officials involved at any level” nor “equal representation from both major parties”, so it shows a lean toward commission-drawn maps without separating those rungs.
